_comment: A lord's commission (docs/LIVING_WORLD_2.md §8): weight 0, so no board posts it; offered by rank in the lord's or steward's conversation and bound to the domain's real state by the 'commission' block (quest/commission/Binder).

objectives.target_name: the band on his lordship's road
objectives.label: Break the band on the road to {other}, {direction} of {settlement}

title: The band on the {other} road
His lordship's road
Cutthroats on the road to {other}
summary: The road from {settlement} to {other} is the most dangerous in the domain. A band holds it, {distance} to the {direction}. His lordship wants it broken.
A band has made the {other} road its own. Break it, {distance} {direction} of {settlement}, and his lordship's road is safe again.
Carters will not take the road to {other}. A band waits along it, {distance} to the {direction}. Clear it in his lordship's name.
offer: Every carter on the {other} road pays the band before he pays the toll. That is an insult to his lordship. Take the band apart, {distance} to the {direction}.
You serve this house, so serve it now: a band sits on the road to {other}, {direction} of here. Break it and come back.
My lord's road, my lord's peace. A band thinks otherwise, {distance} {direction} along the way to {other}. Teach them.
progress: Has the {other} road its peace again?
complete: The road is his lordship's again. You are worth your bread.
Broken, then. The carters will sing of it, and his lordship will remember.
Good. The road to {other} breathes again.
